name: The Saint Wife’s Newlywed Trials
storyline: Dirk, the hero who saved the world, was granted the title of crown prince for defeating the Demon Lord. He was accompanied on his journey by Marianne, a priestess from the countryside. However, the future emperor isn't permitted to marry a commoner, so their fairy-tale ending was never meant to be. Nonetheless, unwilling to give up on Marianne, Dirk asks her to run away with him. Dirk abandons his status to marry Marianne, and they settle down together in a rural village. The two believe they can spend their days in modest peace, the chaos of the past a distant memory, but village life comes with its own struggles. Will the two be able to overcome these hardships and find true happiness?
summary: Play as both Dirk and Marianne. As Dirk, head to the Adventurers' Guild and complete requests to rank up. Fend off monsters in turn-based RPG combat and explore dungeons to obtain items and earn the money you need to get by. As Marianne, grow crops and help out the other villagers. Develop the village by interacting with your new neighbors and assisting them with their problems.
